provenance_note: code_commit identifies the current verification checkout. Historical training commits not present in source reports remain unknown; they are not inferred from this checkout.

limitations: pairs_v1 is a coding-agent development fixture and is not an acceptance gate.
Human labels with provenance, κ ≥ 0.70, and quota are required before cutover.
Do not treat Macro-F1 as available: no failure-mode ground truth ships.
canonical_identity is not used as a positive-pair signal.

pair_diagnostic_caveat: The 12 authored pairs are development fixtures. ONNX hard_negative_same_category: n=3, positives=0, P@5=0; novel_true: n=2, positives=0, P@5=0; paraphrase_positive: n=6, positives=6, P@5=1. Per-class, per-query candidate partitioning and absence of positive controls prevent these figures from establishing novel-match retrieval quality. Do not change these frozen scores; build an independent mixed-candidate benchmark after approval. A confidence interval for novel-true recall is undefined with zero positives.

human_validation.reason: No valid human labels; accuracy is undefined, not zero.

calibration.reason: Not measured; ranking scores are not calibrated defect probabilities.
